analysis.purpose: Turns one PL/SQL file into nodes and intra-file edges: procedures, functions and packages as symbols, plus the tables, columns, statements and conditions that make SQL logic analysable as data rather than text.
responsibilities: Emit symbols for procedures, functions, packages and types
Model tables, views and columns declared in the file
Emit one statement node per DML with the tables and columns it touches
Emit one condition node per branch predicate so rules are queryable

businessRules.rule: Cross-file resolution of calls and table references is the resolver phase job, against a schema catalog built from the whole graph.
businessRules.rationale: Capability honesty — this extractor never guesses across files.

nodes.summary: Symbols, schema and statement-level structure from PL/SQL.
